note: Financial diligence request list. phase: phase1 (core documents, buyer's own low-cost checks), phase2 (paid work and deeper detail), decision (needed by the go/no-go date). when: tags for items that apply only to some businesses; drop them with --exclude (wip: contractors with work in progress; lender-list: rows the SBA lender list (B ids, sba-lender-package) already has, so each request appears once). owner: who provides it.

requests.request: Federal business tax returns, last 3 years, with all schedules
requests.why: Tie reported revenue and expenses to the P&Ls; lenders rely on returns

requests.request: Annual P&L and balance sheet, last 3 years, plus year-to-date with same period prior year
requests.why: Earnings trend and the base for SDE

requests.request: Monthly P&L and balance sheet, last 24 months
requests.why: Seasonality, trends, working capital peg

requests.request: Bank statements for every business account, last 24 months
requests.why: Proof of cash: deposits vs reported revenue

requests.request: Merchant processor statements, last 24 months
requests.why: Card revenue tie-out and chargebacks

requests.request: General ledger detail export for the last 24 months (from the accounting software)
requests.why: Test add-backs and unusual entries line by line

requests.request: Add-back schedule with support for each add-back (receipts, payroll records, statements)
requests.why: Each add-back must be documented to count in SDE

requests.request: Revenue by customer, by year, last 3 years (top 20 at least)
requests.why: Customer concentration, churn and retention

requests.request: Revenue by service or product line and by location, last 3 years
requests.why: Which parts of the business earn the money

requests.request: AR aging at the latest month-end and at each of the last 12 month-ends
requests.why: Collectability, working capital, slow payers

requests.request: AP aging at the latest month-end and at each of the last 12 month-ends
requests.why: Stretched payables before a sale; working capital

requests.request: Payroll registers and quarterly payroll tax filings (federal and state), last 2 years
requests.why: Tie wages to the P&L; payroll tax compliance

requests.request: Owner compensation and benefits detail: salary, distributions, health, vehicles, phone, family on payroll
requests.why: Owner add-backs and the cost of replacing the owner

requests.request: Sales tax returns, last 3 years, and any notices
requests.why: Tie taxable sales to revenue; unpaid sales tax can follow the business

requests.request: Debt schedule: every loan, line of credit, equipment loan and lease, with balances and payoff terms
requests.why: Cash-free, debt-free payoff list and liens

requests.request: Fixed asset list with purchase dates, cost and condition; capital spending by year, last 3 years
requests.why: Capex needs not visible in SDE

requests.request: Inventory listing at latest count, count procedures and write-offs, last 2 years
requests.why: Inventory value, obsolescence, working capital

requests.request: WIP schedule at each month-end, last 12 months, and closed-job margin report, last 2 years
requests.why: Over/under billings and estimating accuracy

requests.request: Schedule of customer deposits, deferred revenue, memberships or prepaid service plans
requests.why: Work already paid for that the buyer will have to deliver

requests.request: Pricing history and any price increases in the last 3 years
requests.why: Whether growth came from price or volume

requests.request: Budget or forecast for the current year, if one exists
requests.why: Seller's expectations versus trend

requests.request: Written explanation of any large or unusual items: one-time revenue, lawsuits, insurance claims, PPP or other grants
requests.why: Normalize earnings

requests.request: Signed authorization for IRS tax transcripts (on the lender's form), to compare with the returns provided
requests.why: Confirms the returns match what was filed; in an SBA change of ownership the lender must verify the seller's financial data against IRS records (source sba-sop-50-10-8-1-seller-tax-verification)

requests.request: Name and contact of the seller's outside CPA or bookkeeper, with the seller's permission to ask questions
requests.why: Faster answers on the books

requests.request: QoE scope agreed and provider engaged (if phase 2 goes ahead)
requests.why: Independent test of earnings and working capital

requests.request: QoE or financial review findings delivered
requests.why: Input to the go/no-go decision

requests.request: Proof of cash tie-out recorded in verification.md
requests.why: Revenue confirmed against bank deposits

requests.request: Updated SDE after diligence adjustments recorded in evaluation.md
requests.why: Basis for go/no-go and any reprice
